"directors"

    unit = 32;
    program name = { native macOS AArch64 fixture };
    modular extensions = audio playback;
    display width = 0;
    display height = 0;

"variables"

    Command Line Fixture = { arm64-fixture };
    Global K Fixture Name = { ARM64 GlobalK fixture! };

"workspace"

    Global K Fixture Write Data = 255;
    Global K Fixture Read Data = 255;

"programme"

    A = Command Line;
    ? [A] != ZERO -> command line fixture failed;
    A + 9;
    B = Command Line Fixture;

"compare command line fixture"

    C = [A];
    ? C != [B] -> command line fixture failed;
    ? C = ZERO -> command line fixture complete;
    A+;
    B+;
    -> compare command line fixture;

"command line fixture complete"

    [Global K Name] = FFFFFFFFh;
    [Global K Command] = K DESTROY;
    isocall;
    ? ok -> global K fixture failed;
    ? [Global K Command] != ZERO -> global K fixture failed;

    [Global K Name] = Global K Fixture Name;
    [Global K Data] = FFFFFFFFh;
    [Global K Command] = K WRITE;
    isocall;
    ? ok -> global K fixture failed;
    ? [Global K Command] != ZERO -> global K fixture failed;

    A = Global K Fixture Write Data;
    B = 255;

"initialize Global K fixture data"

    [A] = B;
    A+;
    B-;
    ? B > ZERO -> initialize Global K fixture data;

    [Global K Name] = Global K Fixture Name;
    [Global K Data] = Global K Fixture Write Data;
    [Global K Command] = K WRITE;
    isocall;
    ? failed -> global K fixture failed;

    [Global K Data] = Global K Fixture Read Data;
    [Global K Command] = K READ;
    isocall;
    ? failed -> global K fixture failed;

    A = Global K Fixture Write Data;
    B = Global K Fixture Read Data;
    C = 255;

"compare Global K fixture data"

    D = [A];
    ? D != [B] -> global K fixture failed;
    A+;
    B+;
    C-;
    ? C > ZERO -> compare Global K fixture data;

    [Global K Data] = FFFFFFFFh;
    [Global K Command] = K DESTROY;
    isocall;
    ? failed -> global K fixture failed;

    [Global K Data] = Global K Fixture Read Data;
    [Global K Command] = K READ;
    isocall;
    ? ok -> global K fixture failed;

    [PCM data Offset] = FFFFFFFFh;
    [PCM data Command] = GET DATA OFFSET;
    isocall;
    ? failed -> audio service failed;
    A = 646F6E65h;
    B = [PCM data Offset];
    C = [PCM data Channels];
    D = [PCM data Bits Per Sample];
    E = [PCM data Samples Per Sec];
    end;

"command line fixture failed"

    fail;

"global K fixture failed"

    fail;

"audio service failed"

    fail;
